From DoStuff — ADHD Micro Break Accountabil.... I have pinpointed the cause of the glitch on the mobile APK and am compiling a fresh package for you now: Why It Was Glitching: The app was attempting to call browser requestFullscreen() during timer countdowns without a direct user touch gesture, which triggers security warnings and stuttering on mobile Android WebViews. Mouse-only drag handlers on the floating capsule did not have native single-touch boundaries (touchstart/touchmove), causing visual drag jitter on mobile touchscreens. The Fix: Added native touch event listeners (touchstart/touchmove/touchend) for smooth dragging. Guarded requestFullscreen() so mobile Android WebViews display smoothly without throwing security exceptions. Rebuilding the clean, live package directly into D:\app APK.S Live Updates. I will update you as soon as the APK finishes compiling!

From Orb. To set it up, create a free developer account at bankaccountdata.gocardless.com, generate your Secret ID and Key, and add them to your portal backend to automatically generate bank authorization links and stream transactions. Xero and QuickBooks use direct Open Banking API partnerships with major banks alongside aggregators like Yodlee and Plaid, but GoCardless gives your app the exact same real-time bank feeds without needing expensive enterprise contracts.

From Orb. It works by generating an official bank link where your users approve read-only access in their banking app via Face ID, streaming live transactions directly into your portal with 100% bank-grade security because passwords and funds are never accessible. Yes, you can legally use this to sell paid plans commercially, as GoCardless acts as the FCA-regulated provider so your SaaS can charge customers without needing its own costly regulatory license.

From Orb. Yes: you can use GoCardless Bank Account Data (formerly Nordigen), which offers a free UK Open Banking API tier where they cover the FCA license and handle the official bank login links, allowing you to connect accounts like Tide and Virgin for free without contacting banks or paying aggregator fees. Alternatively, you can use Tide's free automated statement export feature to pipe transactions directly into your portal's background sync engine with zero external setup.
